Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

pixr 0.1.1

New features

  • get_pix_cnae_stats(): access the new CnaePorteRecebedor endpoint, with PIX statistics by the receiver’s CNAE section, company size, and MEI status.
  • get_pix_dict_users(): access the new PixUsuariosCadastradosDICT endpoint, the monthly series of users registered in the DICT.
  • pix_columns("fraud") now documents the full fraud statistics schema (24 columns), and get_pix_fraud_stats() validates columns against it.
  • pix_endpoints() and pix_ping() now cover all six API endpoints.
  • New vignette: “Receiver Profiles (CNAE) and DICT Users” (vignette("receiver-profiles-dict-users")).

Authors

  • Added ORCID iDs for all authors and aligned the author list with the team’s other packages.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed the User-Agent string sent with API requests, which pointed to a placeholder GitHub URL instead of the package repository.
  • top is now validated: non-numeric or non-positive values abort with a clear message instead of silently sending $top=NA to the API.

Minor improvements

  • pix_timeout() now reads the default from the same internal constant used by the request builder.
  • Added a unit test suite covering the offline helpers (date parsing, URL building, column validation, and formatting).
  • Removed an unused internal helper (format_orderby()).
  • DESCRIPTION now declares Language: en-US and links to the documentation site at https://strategicprojects.github.io/pixr/.
  • Corrected this NEWS file: the 0.1.0 entry listed a function (get_pix_growth_stats()) that was never part of the package.

pixr 0.1.0

Initial CRAN release.

Data access functions

  • get_pix_keys(): PIX keys stock by participant (DICT), with get_pix_keys_summary() and get_pix_keys_by_type() convenience aggregations.
  • get_pix_transactions_by_municipality(): PIX transactions by municipality, with get_pix_transactions_by_state() and get_pix_transactions_by_region() aggregation wrappers.
  • get_pix_transaction_stats(): detailed transaction statistics (payer and receiver type, region, age group, initiation method, and nature), with get_pix_summary() for grouped aggregations and get_pix_transaction_stats_multi() for multiple months.
  • get_pix_fraud_stats(): fraud statistics from the Special Return Mechanism (MED), with get_pix_fraud_stats_multi() for multiple months.

Utilities

  • pix_ping(): test the connection to all API endpoints.
  • pix_query(): low-level custom OData queries against any endpoint.
  • pix_url(): build and inspect the request URL without performing it.
  • pix_endpoints() and pix_columns(): endpoint and column metadata.
  • pix_timeout(): get or set the request timeout (default 120 seconds).
  • year_month_to_date(): convert "YYYYMM" strings to Date.
  • format_brl(): format numbers as Brazilian Real currency.

Package features

  • OData query support (filter, select via columns, orderby, top).
  • Automatic retry with exponential backoff and configurable timeout.
  • Informative progress messages via the cli package.
  • All functions return tibbles for tidyverse compatibility.
